title: 无标题文章
summary: This is probably true, though the truth is much more complicated, societies have made themselves dependent on oil, so the infrastructure is still there, switching to renewable energy (whilst I wholeheartedly agree is the correct choice) takes time, and significant investment. True, but paints "if we just switched" as an easy option. It is our only option.
content:
This is probably true, though the truth is much more complicated, societies have made themselves dependent on oil, so the infrastructure is still there, switching to renewable energy (whilst I wholeheartedly agree is the correct choice) takes time, and significant investment.

True, but paints "if we just switched" as an easy option.

It is our only option.
